create_KukaCamGymEnv: create a KukaCamGymEnv instance with discrete actions and rendering enabled for the KUKA robot camera gym environment
reset_KukaCamGymEnv: reset the KukaCamGymEnv simulation to load a new plane, table, block, and KUKA robot with randomized block position
step_KukaCamGymEnv: step the KukaCamGymEnv with a continuous or discrete action to move the KUKA robot arm toward the block
getExtendedObservation_KukaCamGymEnv: get the extended observation as a 256x341 RGBA camera image from the KUKA robot simulation environment
render_KukaCamGymEnv: render the KukaCamGymEnv as an rgb_array by returning the current camera observation image from the simulation
